Replay fixtures for `tests/test_release_watch.py` (MODEL-216).

A fictional lab, Acme, before and after it releases Acme Two 2 and Acme
Vision 3. The files mimic the shapes the watcher reads: a lab's model page
(IDs in a table and in inlined JSON), the Hugging Face models API, and
OpenRouter's `/api/v1/models`. They are hand-written, not copies of any
real page.
